scripts.dev: mkdir -p dist && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs dist/pdf.worker.min.mjs && NODE_PATH=node_modules esbuild src/main.js styles/style.css --bundle --outdir=dist --outbase=. --sourcemap --watch --serve=3001 --servedir=. --loader:.html=text
scripts.build: NODE_PATH=node_modules esbuild src/main.js styles/style.css --bundle --outdir=dist --outbase=. --minify --loader:.html=text && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs dist/pdf.worker.min.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src/ styles/ tests/ e2e/ ../shared/ index.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/ styles/ tests/ e2e/ ../shared/ index.html
